page_title: NOT 1-2 MCI | Nottingham Forest v Manchester City 27/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+4' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Callum Hudson-Odoi as he is replaced by Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham).
90+1' Phil Foden (Manchester City) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+1' Savinho (Manchester City) produced a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but John Victor thwarted him with a fabulous save.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Here is a change. Rayan Cherki is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Ake (Manchester City).
88' The ball is cleared after Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
87' The fouls committed statistics – 4:13.
87' Substitution. Nicolas Dominguez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
85' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Robert Jones signals that there was no infringement and the goal stands! The Manchester City players celebrate.
84' The Manchester City players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
83' 1 - 2 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Josko Gvardiol knock down. 1:2.
83' Phil Foden (Manchester City) will take the corner.

83' The corner kick from Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
80' Phil Foden (Manchester City) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
80' Phil Foden (Manchester City) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
80' The attendance is 30778.
77' Savinho (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
76' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) swings in a cross from the corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reads it well and gathers the ball.

76' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders. Nottingham will take a corner kick.
75' Referee Robert Jones halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Pep Guardiola, then shows him a yellow.
74' The foul by Savinho (Manchester City) was seen by Robert Jones who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

73' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Phil Foden (Manchester City) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but John Victor pulls off a brilliant save.
73' Tijjani Reijnders will be replaced by Savinho (Manchester City).
72' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
71' Half-chance! Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) plays a pass into the box, but John Victor reacts well to snuff out the attack.
69' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
68' The total number of attempts is 6:10. 2:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
67' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Callum Hudson-Odoi collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
67' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

66' Neco Williams (Nottingham) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the bottom right corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Unbelievable miss! Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
63' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) launches a cross from the corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert to thwart the effort.
62' Nicolo Savona sends a lofted pass into the box, Igor Jesus (Nottingham) shows good awareness to connect with it but blazes his shot high over the crossbar.
60' The free kick from Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Phil Foden (Manchester City) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
57' A pass lands at the feet of Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
56' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
54' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Igor Jesus plays it into the box, and Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) gets on the end of the cross to put it low into the middle of the net. 1:1.
53' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
52' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
51' Phil Foden (Manchester City) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. Manchester City have a corner.

51' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) went on a solo run, tricking his way past defenders, then produced an explosive blast from close range towards the right side of the goal. However, John Victor showed all his agility, deflecting the ball onto the post! What a save! Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

48' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Rayan Cherki, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City), who beats John Victor with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.

47' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is stopped by Gianluigi Donnarumma, who pulls off a glorious save!
46' A clumsy foul by Ruben Dias (Manchester City) and Robert Jones blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Nottingham.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
42' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
40' Wow, what an escape. Phil Foden (Manchester City) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
40' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
39' Neco Williams (Nottingham) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
37' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) tries to find Nicolo Savona, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
36' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
35' Phil Foden (Manchester City) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
32' 2:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 0:0.
32' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
30' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

29' Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Nottingham.
27' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
26' What a miskick by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
25' Referee Robert Jones sees the trip by Nico (Manchester City) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Nottingham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
24' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) attempts to find Matheus Nunes, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
23' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) sprays a pass out to Erling Haaland, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
20' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
18' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

17' Chance! Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
16' Ball possession – 27:73.
15' Nico (Manchester City) sends a long ball in, but John Victor comfortably gathers the ball.
12' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
10' It could have been a good chance to score! Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) fails to release Rayan Cherki with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
9' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) sends a long ball forward to Matheus Nunes, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
8' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Morgan Gibbs-White, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
6' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

5' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
4' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Nottingham will take a throw-in.
2' Manchester City players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
Manchester City will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Today's referee will be Robert Jones.
